	ENDPROC

		thisform.oListador.terminar=.t.
		*clear events
		_screen.Closable=.t.
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.MouseDown
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		thisform.oListador.avance=-5
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.timer
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.enabled=.t.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.MouseUp
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton10.Click
		
		thisform.oListador.avance=-300
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.enabled=.t.
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.timer
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		local moldalias,mvaraux
		
		moldalias=alias()
		select(thisform.oListador.archivoPantalla)
		thisform.oListador.displayhoja(pagina+1)
		
		select(moldalias)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton4.Click
		local moldalias,mvaraux
		moldalias=alias()
		select(thisform.oListador.archivoPantalla)
		
		set filter to
		thisform.oListador.displayHoja(pagina-1)
		
		select(moldalias) 
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton5.MouseDown
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		thisform.oListador.avance=5
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.timer
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.enabled=.t.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton5.MouseUp
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton6.Click
		local moldalias
		
		moldalias=alias()
		select(thisform.oListador.archivoPantalla)
		set filter to
		go bottom
		If thisform.oListador.NroHojaPendiente=0
			thisform.oListador.displayhoja(pagina)
		Else
			thisform.oListador.displayhoja(pagina-1)
		Endif	
				
		
		select(moldalias)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton7.Click
		local moldalias
		moldalias=alias()
		select(thisform.oListador.archivoPantalla)
		
		thisform.oListador.displayhoja(1)
		
		
		select(moldalias) 
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton8.Click
		thisform.oListador.finallistado=.t.
		thisform.oListador.NroHojaPendiente=0
		thisform.hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton9.Click
		
		thisform.oListador.avance=300
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.enabled=.t.
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.timer
		thisform.oListador.tg_timer1.enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE apagarcontroles
		Lparameters lApagar
		
		Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.Enabled=!lApagar
		Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.Enabled=!lApagar
		Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.Enabled=!lApagar
		Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.Enabled=!lApagar
		Thisform.Tg_btnColorLetra.Enabled=!lApagar
		Thisform.tg_cmbFuente.Enabled=!lApagar
		Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.Enabled=!lApagar
		
		
		Thisform.Tg_btnRevertir.Enabled=!lApagar
		Thisform.Tg_btnGrabar.Enabled=!lApagar
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargaranchocolumnas
		Local mmpp
		 
		Thisform.nTamañoTotal=0
		For mmpp=1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.ColumnCount
			If Thisform.oColumnasReporte.Buscar(ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado)+Alltrim(Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).NombreCampo))
				Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).width = Thisform.oColumnasReporte.Leer("Ancho")
			EndIf
			Thisform.nTamañoTotal=Thisform.nTamañoTotal+Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).width
		EndFor 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarcomboelementos
		Thisform.Tg_CmbElemento1.Additem("TITULO")
		Thisform.Tg_CmbElemento1.Additem("EMPRESA")
		Thisform.Tg_CmbElemento1.Additem("CABCORTE")
		Thisform.Tg_CmbElemento1.Additem("COLUMNAS")
		Thisform.Tg_CmbElemento1.Additem("DETALLE")
		Thisform.Tg_CmbElemento1.Additem("PIECORTE")
		Thisform.Tg_CmbElemento1.Additem("TITFILTRO")
		Thisform.Tg_CmbElemento1.Additem("DETFILTRO")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarelementos
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.BoundColumn=2
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ColumnCount=2
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ColumnLines= .F.
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ColumnWidths="100,0"
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.AddItem("Nombre de Empresa",1,1)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListItem(1,2) = "EMPRESA"
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.AddItem("Cabecera Pagina",2,1)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListItem(2,2) = "CABPAG"
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.AddItem("Cabecera Corte",3,1)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListItem(3,2) = "CABCORTE"
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.AddItem("Detalle",4,1)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListItem(4,2) = "DETALLE"
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.AddItem("Pie Corte",5,1)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListItem(5,2) = "PIECORTE"
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.AddItem("Pie Pagina",6,1)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListItem(6,2) = "PIEPAG"
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.AddItem("Columnas",7,1)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListItem(7,2) = "COLUMNAS"
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.AddItem("Titulo Filtros",8,1)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListItem(8,2) = "TITFILTRO"
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.AddItem("Detalle Filtros",9,1)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListItem(9,2) = "DETFILTRO"
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarfuentes
		Local i,vMatrizFuente[1],vGrabacion[1,2]
		If afont(vMatrizFuente)
			FOR i = 1 TO Alen(vMatrizFuente,1)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion		, "Nombre"	,	vMatrizFuente[i])
				ThisForm.oAuxFuentes.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion,.T.)
			ENDFOR
			Thisform.oAuxFuentes.IrPrimero()
			Do While !Thisform.oAuxFuentes.EsEof()
				Thisform.Tg_CmbFuente.Additem(Alltrim(Thisform.oAuxFuentes.Leer("Nombre")))
				Thisform.oAuxFuentes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
			ThisForm.oAuxFuentes.IrPrimero()
			Thisform.Tg_CmbFuente.Value=(Alltrim(Thisform.oAuxFuentes.Leer("Nombre")))
		EndIf 
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargargrilladetalle
		LPARAMETERS msql, vTitulos
		Local mmpp,NroColumna,vGrabar(1),mArchivo
		
		**** Pablo
		thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_CntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.recordsource=""
		marchivo="X"+substr(sys(2015),4,10)
		select &msql into cursor &marchivo
		thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_CntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columncount=0
		thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_CntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.recordsource=marchivo
		
		
		NroColumna=0
		
		Thisform.Cargarpropelemento("DETALLE")
		For mmpp=1 to Alen(Thisform.vColumnas,1)
			
			If !Thisform.oColumnasReporte.Buscar(ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado)+Iif(Empty(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,11]),Iif(Empty(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,7]),Alltrim(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,4]),alltrim(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,7])),"nColValor"+Alltrim(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,7])))
			
			
				=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Listado",			ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"NombreCampo",		Iif(Empty(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,11]),Iif(Empty(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,7]),Alltrim(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,4]),alltrim(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,7])),"nColValor"+Alltrim(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,7])))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Ancho",			Thisform.DarAncho(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,5],thisform.tg_cmbFuente.Value,thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.Value))
				Thisform.oColumnasReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
			EndIf
			If Thisform.vColumnas(mmpp,2)
				With Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle
					NroColumna=NroColumna+1
					.AddColumn(NroColumna)
					.columns(NroColumna).AddProperty("NombreCampo" , Iif(Empty(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,11]),Iif(Empty(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,7]),Alltrim(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,4]),alltrim(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,7])),"nColValor"+Alltrim(thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,7])))
					.columns(NroColumna).header1.Caption = Thisform.vColumnas(mmpp,1)
					.columns(NroColumna).enabled=.f.
					.columns(NroColumna).movable=.f.
					.columns(NroColumna).controlsource=fields(NroColumna,marchivo)
				EndWith
			Endif
		EndFor 
		
		With Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle
			.RecordSourceType= 1
		
			.ReadOnly=.t.
		EndWith
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_CntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.Refresh()
		thisform.refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmargenes
		If Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"MARGENSUP")
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenSup.Value=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("TamMargen")
		Else
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenSup.Value=2.54
		EndIf
		If Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"MARGENINF")
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenInf.Value=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("TamMargen")
		Else
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenInf.Value=2.54
		EndIf
		If Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"MARGENDER")
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenDer.Value=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("TamMargen")
		Else
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenDer.Value=2.54
		EndIf
		If Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"MARGENIZQ")
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenIzq.Value=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("TamMargen")
		Else
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenIzq.Value=2.54
		EndIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarpropelemento
		Lparameters cElemento
		 
		If Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+Alltrim(cElemento))
			thisform.tg_cmbFuente.Value=Alltrim(Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("Fuente"))
			thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.value=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("Tamaño")
			Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("Negrita")
			Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("Cursiva")
			Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("subrayado")
			Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("ColorLetra")
			Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("ColorFondo")
			
		Else
			thisform.tg_cmbFuente.Value="Times New Roman"
			thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.Value=8
			Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value=.F.
			Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value=.F.
			Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value=.F.
			Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra=0
			** REPORTE2008 Se modifica la propiedad.
			Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo=16777215
			
		EndIf
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarpropelementovariable
		Lparameters cElemento
		 
		If Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+Alltrim(cElemento))
			thisform.cFuente=Alltrim(Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("Fuente"))
			thisform.nTamaño=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("Tamaño")
			Thisform.lNegrita=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("Negrita")
			Thisform.lCursiva=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("Cursiva")
			Thisform.lSubrayado=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("subrayado")
			Thisform.nForeColor=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("ColorLetra")
			Thisform.nBackColor=Thisform.oParamReporte.Leer("ColorFondo")
		Else
			thisform.cFuente="Times New Roman"
			thisform.nTamaño=8
			Thisform.lNegrita=.F.
			Thisform.lCursiva=.F.
			Thisform.lSubrayado=.F.
			Thisform.nForeColor=0
			Thisform.nBackColor=16777215
		EndIf
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartamfuente
		LPARAMETERS cFuente
		Local vTam[1]
		
		ThisForm.Tg_CmbTamaño.Clear
		=AFONT(vTam, alltrim(cFuente))
		If Type("vTam")<>T_LOGICAL
			IF vTam[1] = -1
				FOR i = 6 TO 20
					ThisForm.Tg_CmbTamaño.AddItem(ALLTRIM(STR(i)))
					ThisForm.Tg_CmbTamaño.List(ThisForm.Tg_CmbTamaño.Listcount)=alltrim(str(i))
				ENDFOR
			ELSE
				FOR i = 1 TO ALEN(vTam,1)
					ThisForm.Tg_CmbTamaño.AddItem(ALLTRIM(STR(vTam[i])))
					ThisForm.Tg_CmbTamaño.List(ThisForm.Tg_CmbTamaño.Listcount)=alltrim(str(i))
				ENDFOR
			ENDIF
		EndIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darancho
		Lparameters nAncho,cFuente,nTamaño
		Return (TXTWIDTH(Replicate("0",nAncho),cFuente,nTamaño)* FONTMETRIC(6,cFuente,nTamaño)/FONTMETRIC(6))+1
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darformato
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabar
		Local vGrabar(1)
		 
		If Thisform.lCambio
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"listado",			Thisform.listado)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"id_elemento",		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.Value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"FUENTE",			Thisform.tg_cmbFuente.Value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"TAMAÑO",			Iif(Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.Value<6,7,Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.Value))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"NEGRITA",			Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.Value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"CURSIVA",			Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.Value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"SUBRAYADO",		Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.Value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"COLORLETRA",		Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"COLORFONDO",		Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo)
		
			If Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+Alltrim(Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.Value))
				Thisform.oParamReporte.Modificar(@vGrabar,.f.,.t.)
			Else
				Thisform.oParamReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
			EndIf
		EndIf
		
		If 	Thisform.lCambioTamaño
			Thisform.grabartamaños()
		EndIf
		If Thisform.lTamInter
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"listado",				Thisform.listado)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"id_elemento",			"INTERLINEADO")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,	"tamaño",				Thisform.tg_sprInterlineado.value)
			If Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"INTERLINEADO")
				Thisform.oParamReporte.Modificar(@vGrabar,.f.,.t.)
			Else
				Thisform.oParamReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
			EndIf	
		EndIf
		
		If 	Thisform.lCambioMargenes
			Thisform.grabarmargenes()
		EndIf
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarmargenes
		Local vGrabar(1)
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"TamMargen",			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenSup.Value)
		If !Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"MARGENSUP")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Listado",			ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Id_Elemento",		"MARGENSUP")
			Thisform.oParamReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
		Else
			Thisform.oParamReporte.Modificar(@vGrabar,.f.,.t.)
		EndIf
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"TamMargen",			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenInf.Value)
		If !Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"MARGENINF")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Listado",			ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Id_Elemento",		"MARGENINF")
			Thisform.oParamReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
		Else
			Thisform.oParamReporte.Modificar(@vGrabar,.f.,.t.)
		EndIf
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"TamMargen",			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenDer.Value)
		If !Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"MARGENDER")	
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Listado",			ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Id_Elemento",		"MARGENDER")
			Thisform.oParamReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
		Else
			Thisform.oParamReporte.Modificar(@vGrabar,.f.,.t.)
		EndIf
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"TamMargen",			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntMargenes.tg_spnMargenIzq.Value)
		If !Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"MARGENIZQ")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Listado",			ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Id_Elemento",		"MARGENIZQ")
			Thisform.oParamReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
		Else
			Thisform.oParamReporte.Modificar(@vGrabar,.f.,.t.)
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabartamaños
		Local mmpp,vGrabar(1)
		
		For mmpp = 1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntdetalle.tg_grdDetalle.ColumnCount
			=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Ancho",			thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntdetalle.tg_grdDetalle.Columns(mmpp).width)
			If !Thisform.oColumnasReporte.Buscar(ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado)+Alltrim(Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntdetalle.tg_grdDetalle.Columns(mmpp).NombreCampo))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Listado",			ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"NombreCampo",		ALLTRIM(Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntdetalle.tg_grdDetalle.Columns(mmpp).NombreCampo))
		
				Thisform.oColumnasReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
			Else
				Thisform.oColumnasReporte.Modificar(@vGrabar,.f.,.t.)
			EndIf
		EndFor 
		
	ENDPROC

							Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPag.Controls(mmpp).FontUnderline =Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value
							Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPag.Controls(mmpp).ForeColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra

						EndIf

				Case cElemento="EMPRESA"

					Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPag.tg_lblNombreEmpresa.FontItalic=Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value
					Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPag.tg_lblNombreEmpresa.FontUnderline=Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value
					Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPag.tg_lblNombreEmpresa.ForeColor=Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
					Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPag.tg_lblNombreEmpresa.BackColor=Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
		
				Case cElemento="CABCORTE"
					For mmpp=1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraCor.ControlCount
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraCor.Controls(mmpp).FontName=Thisform.tg_cmbFuente.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraCor.Controls(mmpp).FontSize=Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraCor.Controls(mmpp).FontBold =Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraCor.Controls(mmpp).FontItalic =Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraCor.Controls(mmpp).FontUnderline =Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraCor.Controls(mmpp).ForeColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraCor.Controls(mmpp).BackColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
					Endfor
					Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraCor.BackColor=Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
				
				Case cElemento="DETALLE" 
					For mmpp=1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columnCount
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).FontName=Thisform.tg_cmbFuente.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).FontSize=Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).FontBold =Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).FontItalic =Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).FontUnderline =Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).ForeColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).BackColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).text1.DisabledBackcolor=Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).text1.DisabledForecolor=Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
					Endfor
					*Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.HighlightBackColor=Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
					*Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.HighlightForeColor=Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
					Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.BackColor=Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
		
				Case cElemento="COLUMNAS"
					
					For mmpp=1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columnCount
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).header1.FontName=Thisform.tg_cmbFuente.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).header1.FontSize=Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).header1.FontBold =Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).header1.FontItalic =Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).header1.FontUnderline =Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).header1.ForeColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntDetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).header1.BackColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
					Endfor
		
		
				Case cElemento="PIECORTE"
					For mmpp=1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCortePie.ControlCount
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCortePie.Controls(mmpp).FontName=Thisform.tg_cmbFuente.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCortePie.Controls(mmpp).FontSize=Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCortePie.Controls(mmpp).FontBold =Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCortePie.Controls(mmpp).FontItalic =Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCortePie.Controls(mmpp).FontUnderline =Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCortePie.Controls(mmpp).ForeColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCortePie.Controls(mmpp).BackColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
					Endfor
					Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCortePie.BackColor=Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
					
				Case cElemento="PIEPAG"
					For mmpp=1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPie.ControlCount
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPie.Controls(mmpp).FontName=Thisform.tg_cmbFuente.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPie.Controls(mmpp).FontSize=Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPie.Controls(mmpp).FontBold =Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPie.Controls(mmpp).FontItalic =Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPie.Controls(mmpp).FontUnderline =Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPie.Controls(mmpp).ForeColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
						Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPie.Controls(mmpp).BackColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
					Endfor
					Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntCabeceraPie.BackColor=Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
				Case cElemento="DETFILTRO"
				 
					For mmpp=1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntfiltros.ControlCount
						With Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntfiltros.Controls(mmpp)
							If At("TG_LABELDETFILTRO",Upper(.name))>0
								.FontName=Thisform.tg_cmbFuente.value
								.FontSize=Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.value
								.FontBold =Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value
								.FontItalic =Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value
								.FontUnderline =Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value
								.ForeColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
								.BackColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
							EndIf
						EndWith
					Endfor
					Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntfiltros.BackColor=Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
				Case cElemento="TITFILTRO"
					For mmpp=1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntfiltros.ControlCount
						With Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.tg_cntfiltros.Controls(mmpp)
							If At("TG_LBLTITULOFILTRO",Upper(.name))>0
								.FontName=Thisform.tg_cmbFuente.value
								.FontSize=Thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.value
								.FontBold =Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value
								.FontItalic =Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value
								.FontUnderline =Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value
								.ForeColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra
								.BackColor =Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo
							EndIf
						EndWith
					Endfor
			EndCase
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LPARAMETERS cNombreListado,vColumnas,msql
		local marchivo
		private lCancela
		dodefault()
		this.AddObject("oCstSistemaVentas","Tg_SistemaVentas")
		this.AddObject("oCstSistemaStock","Tg_SistemaStock")
		this.AddObject("oCstConvMonUniversal","Tg_ConvMonUniversal")
		Thisform.nTamañoTotal=0
		Thisform.Listado=cNombreListado
		Thisform.OrdenarVector(@vColumnas)
		Acopy(vColumnas,Thisform.vColumnas)
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oParamReporte","Tg_Tabla","ParametroReporte","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oAuxFuentes","Tg_Tabla","Aux_Fuentes","Nombre")
		Thisform.AddObject("oAuxDetalle","Tg_Tabla","Aux_DetalleReporte")
		Thisform.AddObject("oColumnasReporte","Tg_Tabla","ColumnasReporte","Clave")
		
		
		thisform.oAuxFuentes.SetearProp("BOT")
		ThisForm.CargarFuentes()
		ThisForm.CargarElementos()
		Thisform.Apagarcontroles(.T.)
		ThisForm.Caption=ThisForm.Caption+" ("+Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+")"
		Thisform.cargarGrillaDetalle(msql)
		Thisform.Inicializarformato("TODOS")
		Thisform.Cargaranchocolumnas()
		Thisform.CargarMargenes()
		If Thisform.oParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(thisform.Listado)+"INTERLINEADO")
			Thisform.tg_sprInterlineado.Value=Thisform.oParamReporte.leer("tamaño")
		Else
			Thisform.tg_sprInterlineado.Value=10
			Thisform.lTamInter=.t.
			Thisform.Tg_btnGrabar.Enabled=.T.
			Thisform.Tg_btnRevertir.Enabled=.T.
		ENDIF
		
		** ANOTACION
			** Las configuraciones se almacenan en ColumnasReportes y ParametrosReportes
		**
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ordenarvector
		Lparameters vVector
		Local mmpp,vVectorAux(1),lSalir
		 
		lSalir=.F.
		DO While !lSalir
			lSalir=.T.
			For mmpp=2 to Alen(vVector,1)
				If vVector(mmpp,3)<vVector(mmpp-1,3)
					Acopy(vVector,vVectorAux,Alen(vVector,2)*(mmpp-2)+1,Alen(vVector,2),1)
					Acopy(vVector,vVector,Alen(vVector,2)*(mmpp-1)+1,Alen(vVector,2),Alen(vVector,2)*(mmpp-2)+1)
					Acopy(vVectorAux,vVector,1,Alen(vVector,2),Alen(vVector,2)*(mmpp-1)+1)
					lSalir=.F.
				Endif
			EndFor 
		Enddo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE revertir
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.Enabled= .T.
		Thisform.Apagarcontroles(.T.)
		Thisform.lCambio=.F.
		Thisform.lCambioTamaño=.F.
		Thisform.lTamInter=.f.
		Thisform.lCambioMargenes=.f.
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.ListIndex=-1
		thisform.tg_cmbFuente.Value="Times New Roman"
		thisform.tg_cmbTamaño.Value=10
		Thisform.tg_chkNegrita.value=.F.
		Thisform.tg_chkCursiva.value=.F.
		Thisform.tg_chkSubrayado.value=.F.
		Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra=0
		Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo=16777215
		Thisform.Inicializarformato("TODOS")
		Thisform.Cargaranchocolumnas()
		ThisForm.Tg_sprInterlineado.Enabled = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE sumartamañoscolumnas
		Local nCont,mmpp
		nCont=0
		For mmpp=1 to Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntdetalle.tg_grdDetalle.ColumnCount
			nCont=nCont+Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.tg_cntdetalle.tg_grdDetalle.columns(mmpp).width
		EndFor 
		
		Return nCont
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnColorFondo.Click
		Local nColor
		nColor=GetColor(Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo)
		If nColor<>-1
			Thisform.tg_btnColorFondo.ColorFondo=nColor
			Thisform.inicializarformato(ThisForm.tg_cmbElemento.value)
			Thisform.lCambio=.T.
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnColorFondo.Init
		DoDefault()
		This.AddProperty("ColorFondo",0)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnColorLetra.Click
		Local nColor
		nColor=GetColor(Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra)
		If nColor<>-1
			Thisform.tg_btnColorLetra.ColorLetra=nColor
			Thisform.inicializarformato(ThisForm.tg_cmbElemento.value)
			Thisform.lCambio=.T.
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnColorLetra.Init
		DoDefault()
		This.AddProperty("ColorLetra",0)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnGrabar.Click
		Thisform.Grabar()
		Thisform.Revertir()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnRevertir.Click
		If Thisform.lcambio or Thisform.lcambiotamaño or Thisform.lTamInter
			If fMensPregunto("¿Desea Grabar los Cambios.?","N")="S"
				Thisform.Grabar()
			EndIf
		EndIf 
		Thisform.Revertir()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnSalir.Click
		If Thisform.lcambio or thisform.lcambioTamaño or Thisform.lTamInter or Thisform.lCambioMargenes
			If fMensPregunto("¿Desea Grabar los Cambios.?","N")="S"
				Thisform.Grabar()
			EndIf
		EndIf 
		thisform.Release
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_chkCursiva.Click
		Thisform.inicializarformato(ThisForm.tg_cmbElemento.value)
		Thisform.lCambio=.T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_chkCursiva.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.lCambio=.T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_chkNegrita.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.inicializarformato(ThisForm.tg_cmbElemento.value)
		Thisform.lCambio=.T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_chkSubrayado.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.inicializarformato(ThisForm.tg_cmbElemento.value)
		Thisform.lCambio=.T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbElemento.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.cargarpropelemento(This.Value)
		Thisform.tg_cmbElemento.Enabled= .F.
		Thisform.Apagarcontroles(.F.)
		If This.Value="DETFILTRO" or This.Value="TITFILTRO"
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page2.SetFocus()
		Else
			Thisform.tg_paginaReporte.page1.SetFocus()
		ENDIF
		IF this.Value = "CABCORTE"
			ThisForm.Tg_sprInterlineado.Enabled = .T.
		ELSE
			ThisForm.Tg_sprInterlineado.Enabled = .F.
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbFuente.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.CargarTamFuente(thisform.Tg_CmbFuente.value)
		Thisform.inicializarformato(ThisForm.tg_cmbElemento.value)
		Thisform.lCambio=.T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbFuente.ProgrammaticChange
		ThisForm.CargarTamFuente(thisform.Tg_CmbFuente.value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbTamaño.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.inicializarformato(ThisForm.tg_cmbElemento.value)
		Thisform.lCambio=.T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_paginaReporte.Page1.Tg_CntDetalle.MouseMove
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		if Thisform.nTamañoTotal<>Thisform.sumartamañoscolumnas()
			Thisform.lCambiotamaño=.t.
			Thisform.tg_btnGrabar.Enabled=.T.
			Thisform.tg_btnRevertir.Enabled=.T.
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_paginaReporte.Page1.Tg_CntDetalle.Tg_grdDetalle.Refresh
		*!*Pongo este comentario para que no se ejecute el Evento Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_paginaReporte.Page2.Tg_cntMargenes.Tg_spnMargenDer.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.lCambioMargenes=.t.
		Thisform.Tg_btnGrabar.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.Tg_btnRevertir.Enabled=.T.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_paginaReporte.Page2.Tg_cntMargenes.Tg_spnMargenInf.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.lCambioMargenes=.t.
		Thisform.Tg_btnGrabar.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.Tg_btnRevertir.Enabled=.T.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_paginaReporte.Page2.Tg_cntMargenes.Tg_spnMargenIzq.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.lCambioMargenes=.t.
		Thisform.Tg_btnGrabar.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.Tg_btnRevertir.Enabled=.T.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_paginaReporte.Page2.Tg_cntMargenes.Tg_spnMargenSup.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.lCambioMargenes=.t.
		Thisform.Tg_btnGrabar.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.Tg_btnRevertir.Enabled=.T.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_sprInterlineado.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.lTamInter=.t.
		Thisform.Tg_btnGrabar.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.Tg_btnRevertir.Enabled=.T.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cancelar
		thisform.hide

	PROCEDURE cargarhasta
		thisform.Tg_TexTbox2.Value=thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value
		Return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lparameters mtitulo,mdesde,mhasta,mpicture,cArchivo,lvalido
		local oTextClave
		tg_form::init
		
		
		*** Diego
		thisform.lguardo_rango = .f.
		thisform.lborro_rango = .f.
		*** Diego
		
		oTextBox="TG_"+alltrim(cArchivo)
		if type("cArchivo")="L".or.alltrim(cArchivo)=""
			oTextBox="TG_TEXTBOX"
		else
			oTextBox="TG_"+alltrim(cArchivo)
		endif
		thisform.addObject("Tg_textbox1",oTextBox)
		thisform.addObject("Tg_textbox2",oTextBox)
		
		*** Febrero 2010
		if !lvalido
			thisform.Tg_TextBox1.ValidExpresion="thisform.CargarHasta()"
		endif	
		*** Febrero 2010
		
		this.tg_label3.caption=mtitulo
		if type("cArchivo")="L".or.alltrim(cArchivo)=""
			this.tg_textbox1.inputmask=mpicture
			this.tg_textbox2.inputmask=mpicture
			this.tg_textbox1.value=mdesde
			this.tg_textbox2.value=mhasta
			this.tg_textbox1.Width=Len(alltrim(mpicture))*10
			this.tg_textbox2.Width=Len(alltrim(mpicture))*10	
		else
			this.tg_textbox1.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
			this.tg_textbox2.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
			this.tg_textbox1.SetearValorInicial(mDesde)
			this.tg_textbox2.SetearValorInicial(mHasta)
		endif
		
		
		this.tg_textbox1.left=51
		this.tg_textbox1.top=27
		this.tg_textbox2.left=51
		this.tg_textbox2.top=72
		this.tg_textbox1.visible=.t.
		this.tg_textbox2.visible=.t.
		this.tg_textbox1.setfocus
		
		
		this.desde=mdesde
		this.hasta=mhasta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar2.Click
		if thisform.tg_textbox2.value>=thisform.tg_textbox1.value or empty(thisform.tg_textbox2.value)
			thisform.desde=thisform.tg_textbox1.value
			thisform.hasta=thisform.tg_textbox2.value
		
			thisform.hide
		else
			=fMensAceptar(TG_RANGOINVALIDO)
		endif
		
		************ Diego 03-07-08
		
		if ThisForm.Tg_checkbox1.value 
		      
		      **thisform.GuardoFormato
		      thisform.lguardo_rango = .t.
		
		endif
		
		************ Diego 03-07-08
		
		************ Diego 03-07-08
		
		if ThisForm.Tg_checkbox3.value 
		      
		      **thisform.GuardoFormato
		      thisform.lborro_rango = .t.
		
		endif
		
		************ Diego 03-07-08
		
		
		**** Diego 01-09
		thisform.ltodos_formatos = .f.
		if ThisForm.Tg_checkbox2.value 
		      
		      **thisform.GuardoFormato
		      thisform.ltodos_formatos = .t.
		
		endif
		**** Diego 01-09
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
