	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_textbox3' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		Height = 21, ;
		Left = 272, ;
		Name = "Tg_textbox3", ;
		TabIndex = 4, ;
		Top = 265, ;
		Width = 132, ;
		ZOrderSet = 21
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_textbox4' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		BackStyle = 1, ;
		DisabledBackColor = 255,0,0, ;
		Enabled = .F., ;
		Height = 15, ;
		Left = 568, ;
		Name = "Tg_textbox4", ;
		TabIndex = 0, ;
		Top = 264, ;
		Width = 13, ;
		ZOrderSet = 10
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_textbox5' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		BackStyle = 0, ;
		DisabledBackColor = 255,0,0, ;
		Enabled = .F., ;
		Height = 15, ;
		Left = 568, ;
		Name = "Tg_textbox5", ;
		TabIndex = 0, ;
		Top = 282, ;
		Width = 13, ;
		ZOrderSet = 11
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_textbox6' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		BackStyle = 1, ;
		DisabledBackColor = 0,0,255, ;
		Enabled = .F., ;
		Height = 15, ;
		Left = 568, ;
		Name = "Tg_textbox6", ;
		TabIndex = 0, ;
		Top = 300, ;
		Width = 13, ;
		ZOrderSet = 12
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_textbox7' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		BackStyle = 0, ;
		DisabledForeColor = 0,0,0, ;
		Enabled = .F., ;
		Left = 272, ;
		Name = "Tg_textbox7", ;
		TabIndex = 4, ;
		Top = 293, ;
		Width = 132, ;
		ZOrderSet = 24
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />
	
	PROCEDURE aceptar
		local mmpp,marchivo
		dimension thisform.vtitulos[thisform.tg_grid1.columncount,3]
		for mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vtitulos,1)
			thisform.vtitulos[mmpp,1]=thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).columnorder
			thisform.vtitulos[mmpp,2]=thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).width
			thisform.vtitulos[mmpp,3]=thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).header1.caption
		endfor
		marchivo=alltrim(thisform.archivo)+".dbf"
		select(alltrim(thisform.archivo))
		use
		
		thisform.hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE anchototal
		local mmpp,mancho
		mancho=0
		for mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.columncount
			mancho=mancho+thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).width/7
		endfor
		mancho=mancho+thisform.tg_grid1.columncount-1+this.SAngriaFija
		return int(mancho)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE colorear
		lparameters mancho,lTodosTitulos
		local mmpp,manchocol
		nDesde=iif(lTodosTitulos,1,thisform.headerSel)
		nHasta=iif(lTodosTitulos,thisform.tg_grid1.columncount,thisform.headerSel)
		
		for mmpp=nDesde to nHasta
			manchocol=thisform.tg_Grid1.columns(mmpp).width/7
			do case
				case manchocol<thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,1]
					thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).header1.backcolor=rgb(255,0,0)
			    	thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).header1.forecolor=rgb(255,255,255)
				case manchocol>thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,1]
					thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).header1.backcolor=rgb(0,0,255)
			    	thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).header1.forecolor=rgb(255,255,255)
				case manchocol=thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,1]
					thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).header1.backcolor=thisform.auxiliarcolor
			    	thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).header1.forecolor=rgb(255,255,255)
			
			endcase		
		endfor
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSelAnt).backcolor=rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSelAnt).forecolor=rgb(0,0,0)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).backcolor=rgb(0,0,164)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).forecolor=rgb(255,255,255)
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lparameters msql,vtitulos,vCorteControl,mtituloform
		local marchivo,mmpp
		private lCancela
		tg_form::init
		thisform.Setearcaption(mtituloform+" "+"(Preliminar)")
		lCancela=.f.
		thisform.archivo="X"+substr(sys(2015),4,10)
		thisform.tg_grid1.recordsource=""
		marchivo=thisform.archivo
		On escape do cancelar
		this.AddObject("oCstSistemaVentas","Tg_SistemaVentas")
		this.AddObject("oCstSistemaStock","Tg_SistemaStock")
		this.AddObject("oCstConvMonUniversal","Tg_ConvMonUniversal")
		
		select &msql into cursor &marchivo
		
		
		
		if lCancela
			this.CancelaProcesoEscape=.t.
			on escape
			thisform.release
			return
		endif
		
		on escape
		this.SAngriaFija=0
		If Type("vCorteControl[1,6]")<>T_LOGICAL
			for mmpp=1 to alen(vCorteControl,1)
				this.SangriaFija=Max(this.SangriaFija,vCorteControl[mmpp,6])
			endfor	
		Endif	
		thisform.tg_grid1.columncount=0
		thisform.tg_grid1.recordsource=marchivo
		thisform.tg_grid1.HeaderHeight=14
		for mmpp=1 to alen(vtitulos,1)
			dimension thisform.vColumnas[mmpp,3]
			thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,1]=max(vtitulos[mmpp,13],len(alltrim(vtitulos[mmpp,1])))
			thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,2]=vtitulos[mmpp,13]
			thisform.vcolumnas[mmpp,3]=vtitulos[mmpp,14]
			thisform.tg_grid1.addobject("column"+alltrim(str(mmpp)),"mycolumn")
			thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(mmpp).InputMask=alltrim(vtitulos[mmpp,15])
			thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).controlsource=fields(mmpp,marchivo)
			thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).header1.caption=alltrim(vtitulos[mmpp,1])
			thisform.tg_grid1.columns(mmpp).width=vtitulos[mmpp,4]
		
		endfor
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.setall("fontname","courier new","textbox")
		thisform.tg_grid1.setall("fontsize",8,"textbox")
		thisform.tg_grid1.setall("enabled",.f.,"textbox")
		thisform.tg_grid1.setall("fontbold",.f.,"textbox")
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.setall("fontbold",.t.,"header")
		thisform.tg_grid1.setall("fontname","courier new","header")
		thisform.tg_grid1.setall("fontsize",8,"header")
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.setall("fontname","courier new","mycolumn")
		thisform.tg_grid1.setall("alignment",3,"mycolumn")
		
		thisform.auxiliarcolor=rgb(128,128,128)
		
		thisform.headersel=1
		thisform.headerselant=1
		thisform.colorear(int(thisform.tg_grid1.column1.width/7),.t.)
		thisform.MostrarValores(.t.)
		thisform.refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvalores
		lparameters lColumna
		thisform.tg_spinner1.value=int(thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).width/7)
		thisform.tg_textbox1.value=thisform.anchototal()
		thisform.tg_textbox2.value=thisform.vcolumnas[thisform.headerSel,1]
		if lColumna
			thisform.tg_textbox3.value=thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).header1.caption
			thisform.tg_textbox7.value=thisform.vcolumnas[thisform.headerSel,3]
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar2.Click
		local marchivo
		thisform.mcancela=.t.
		marchivo=alltrim(thisform.archivo)+".dbf"
		select(alltrim(thisform.archivo))
		use
		
		thisform.hide
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		local mancho
		
		thisform.tg_textbox3.value=thisform.tg_textbox7.value
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).header1.caption=alltrim(thisform.tg_textbox7.value)
		thisform.vcolumnas[thisform.headerSel,1]=max(thisform.vcolumnas[thisform.headerSel,2],len(alltrim(alltrim(thisform.tg_textbox7.value))))
		mancho=int(thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).width/7)
		thisform.colorear(mancho,.f.)
		thisform.mostrarValores(.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.clickheader
		lparameters nColumna
		local mvaraux,mancho,mmpp
		*mvaraux="this."+oColumnaNombre
		
		thisform.headerselant=thisform.headersel
		*thisform.headersel=&mvaraux..columnorder
		thisform.headersel=nColumna
		
		
		
		*mancho=int(&mvaraux..width/7)
		mancho=int(this.columns(nColumna).width/7)
		if mancho=0
			mancho=1
		endif
		
		
		*&mvaraux..width=mancho*7
		this.columns(nColumna).width=mancho*7
		
		
		thisform.MostrarValores(.t.)
		thisform.colorear(mancho,.f.)	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickheader
		lparameters nColumna
		local mvaraux,mancho,mmpp
		*mvaraux="this."+oColumnaNombre
		thisform.headerselant=thisform.headersel
		thisform.headersel=nColumna
			
		
		mancho=thisform.vcolumnas[nColumna,1]
		this.columns(nColumna).width=mancho*7
		
		thisform.MostrarValores(.t.)
		thisform.colorear(mancho,.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Refresh
		** que no haga nada sino me toca el color de los headers
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_spinner1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headersel).width=this.value*7	
		
		thisform.tg_textbox1.value=thisform.anchototal()
		thisform.colorear(this.value,.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox3.InteractiveChange
		local mancho
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).header1.caption=alltrim(this.value)
		thisform.vcolumnas[thisform.headerSel,1]=max(thisform.vcolumnas[thisform.headerSel,2],len(alltrim(this.value)))
		mancho=int(thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).width/7)
		thisform.colorear(mancho,.f.)
		thisform.mostrarValores(.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox7.InteractiveChange
		local mancho
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).header1.caption=alltrim(this.value)
		thisform.vcolumnas[thisform.headerSel,1]=max(thisform.vcolumnas[thisform.headerSel,2],len(alltrim(this.value)))
		mancho=int(thisform.tg_grid1.columns(thisform.headerSel).width/7)
		thisform.colorear(mancho,.f.)
		thisform.mostrarValores(.f.)
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE acumularsaldo
		lparameters nValor,lSigno,nValorInicial
		local nSigno
		
		nSigno=iif(lSigno,1,-1)
		
		thisform.SaldoAcumulado=thisform.SaldoAcumulado+nSigno*nValor
		
		return thisform.SaldoAcumulado
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarcolumna
		lparameters mtitulo,mdato,mancho,mdecimales,lImprimirCeros
		if type("mdecimales")=T_LOGICAL
			mdecimales=0
		endif
		
		this.CantColumnas=this.CantColumnas+1
		dimension this.vtitulos[this.CantColumnas,5]
		
		this.vtitulos[this.CantColumnas,1]=mtitulo
		
		
		this.vtitulos[this.CantColumnas,2]=mdato
		
		this.vtitulos[this.CantColumnas,3]=mancho
		this.vtitulos[this.CantColumnas,4]=mdecimales
		this.vtitulos[this.CantColumnas,5]=lImprimirCeros
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarhojas
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE comenzarhoja
		Local mDate
		local cImprimir,cImprimirFinal ,nContador ,nPosInicial,nPosFinal ,nPosFinalAbsoluta 
		
		mDate=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		this.nroHoja=this.nroHoja+1
		
		if this.Salida=TG_IMPRESORA
			this.SaltarLinea(1)	
			this.imprimir(0,oApp.CargarNombreEmpresa(),.f.,.f.,.t.,.f.)
			
			this.imprimir(thisform.AnchoImpresora-len(dtoc(mdate)+" "+time()),"Hoja: "+alltrim(str(this.NroHoja)),.t.,.f.,.t.,.f.)
			If Eval(this.ImprimeFechaYHora)
				this.imprimir(thisform.AnchoImpresora-len(dtoc(mdate)+" "+time()),dtoc(mdate)+" "+time(),.t.,.f.,.t.,.f.)
			Endif	
			this.imprimir(0,this.titulo,.t.,.t.,.t.,.f.)
			if this.titulosColumnas<>""
				this.subrayar
				
				this.imprimir(0,this.titulosColumnas,.t.,.t.,.f.,.f.)
				this.subrayar
			else
				this.saltarLinea(1)
			endif
		
			&& AGREGADO LUCAS 21/10/2016 - TRANSPORTE DE HOJA 
			If Type("This.ImprimeTransporte") <> "L" And eval(This.ImprimeTransporte) 
				If !This.IngreseAFinalizarListado
					&&cImprimir = UPPER(oApp.vdetallesumacorte[6])
					
					cImprimir = STRTRAN(UPPER(oApp.vdetallesumacorte[6]), "TOTALES:" , "TRANSP.:")
					
					If !Empty(cImprimir)
						cImprimirFinal = ""
						nContador = 1
						nPosInicial=At("STR(NSUM",cImprimir,nContador)	
		
						cImprimirFinal = SUBSTR(cImprimir,1,nPosInicial-1)
		
						Do While nPosInicial > 0
		
							nPosFinal = AT(",",SUBSTR(cImprimir,nPosInicial,Len(cImprimir)))
							nPosFinalAbsoluta = nPosInicial + nPosFinal  
							
							cImprimirFinal = cImprimirFinal + STRTRAN(SUBSTR(cImprimir,nPosInicial, nPosFinal), "6,", "TRANSPORTE,") 
							nContador = nContador  + 1
							
							nPosInicial=At("STR(NSUM",cImprimir,nContador)	
							
							If nPosInicial > 0
								cImprimirFinal = cImprimirFinal + SUBSTR(cImprimir, nPosFinalAbsoluta , nPosInicial - nPosFinalAbsoluta )
							Else
								cImprimirFinal = cImprimirFinal + SUBSTR(cImprimir, nPosFinalAbsoluta , Len(cImprimir))
							Endif
						EndDo
		
						this.imprimir(0,eval(Alltrim(cImprimirFinal)),.t.,.t.,.f.,.t.)	
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
			&& FIN AGREGADO LUCAS 21/10/2016 - TRANSPORTE DE HOJA 
		
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE comenzarlistado
		Local  mmpp,malias,mvaraux,vGrabacion,lActivarAlternate,cArchivo,mmmppp,cCampo,nRepetido,vCamposExcel[1],i
		Local  cNomImpresora,nPosicion, lSalidaWord
		*** VERSION NUEVA *** 
		Local cArchivo
		*** VERSION NUEVA *** 
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		lSalidaWord=.F.
		lActivarAlternate=.F.
		If thisform.Salida=TG_WORD or thisform.Salida=TG_ASCII
			If thisform.Salida=TG_WORD
				lSalidaWord = .t.
				If Type("this.ArchivoAGrabar")=T_CHARACTER and !Empty(this.ArchivoAGrabar)
					cArchivo=This.ArchivoAGrabar
				Else
					cArchivo=GetFile("Doc","1")
					*** VERSION NUEVA
					thisform.archivomail = cArchivo	
					*** VERSION NUEVA
				Endif	
			Else
				If Type("this.ArchivoAGrabar")=T_CHARACTER and !Empty(this.ArchivoAGrabar)
					cArchivo=This.ArchivoAGrabar
				Else
					cArchivo=GetFile("Txt","1")
					*** VERSION NUEVA
					thisform.archivomail = cArchivo	
					*** VERSION NUEVA
				Endif	
			Endif	
			If !Empty(cArchivo)
				lActivarAlternate=.t.	
			Else 
				Return .f.	
			Endif	
			
			*** VERSION NUEVA *** 
			IF FILE(thisform.archivomail)
				IF this.emailadjunto=.t.
					Thisform.enviaremailadjunto(alltrim(thisform.archivomail))	
				Endif	
			Endif	
			*** VERSION NUEVA *** 	
			
			thisform.Salida=TG_IMPRESORA
		Endif
		
		&& Aca Gustavo 09-06-2003
		If lSalidaWord
			If ThisForm.oTerminal.Buscar(alltrim(oApp.Maquina))
				cNomImpresora=iif(empty(alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oTerminal.Leer("IMP_DEF")))),oApp.TomarMaximoString(),alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oTerminal.Leer("IMP_DEF"))))
			Endif
		Else
			cNomImpresora=upper(alltrim(thisform.NombreImpresora))
			nPosicion=at("/SES",cNomImpresora)
			
			* para windows 2003 server
		    if nPosicion=0
		       nPosicion=at("EN LA SES",cNomImpresora)
		    endif
		    
		    if nPosicion=0
		       nPosicion=at("IN SES",cNomImpresora)
		    endif
		    
		    && 2008 server
		    
		   	if nPosicion=0 and at("REDIRECCIONADO",cNomImpresora)<>0
			   nPosicion=at("(",cNomImpresora)
			endif  	
			
		   	if nPosicion=0 and at("REDIRECTED",cNomImpresora)<>0
			   nPosicion=at("(",cNomImpresora)
			endif 
				
			If nPosicion>0
				 cNomImpresora=substr(alltrim(cNomImpresora),1,nPosicion-1)
			Endif
		endif	
		cImpresora="ALLTRIM(UPPER(Nombre))="+"'"+alltrim(cNomImpresora)+"'"+" and "+"Maquina="+"'"+alltrim(oApp.Maquina)+"'"
		*************************************
		
		If !thisform.oTblImpresoras.Localizar(cImpresora) or empty(cNomImpresora) &&& Agregado  or empty(cNomImpresora) 29-04-2001  or empty(cNomImpresora)
		    If thisform.fax
			    thisform.oTblImpresoras.Localizar("Nombre='DEFFAX'")
		    Else
		        thisform.oTblImpresoras.Localizar("Nombre='DEFIMP'")            
		    Endif     
		
		    if .f. &&& A revisar 29-04-2011
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina",oapp.Maquina)      
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre",thisform.NombreImpresora)
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"AnchoDefault",thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("AnchoDefault"))
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"LargoDefault",thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("LargoDefault"))
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"FontDraft",thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("FontDraft"))
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"FontComprimido",thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("FontComprimido"))
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"FontEnfatizadoDraft",thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("FontEnfatizadoDraft"))                               
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"FontEnfatizadoComprimido",thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("FontEnfatizadoComprimido"))                               
		
		       thisform.oTblImpresoras.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		    endif     
		    &&& A revisar 29-04-2011
		Endif     
		
		
		thisform.AnchoHojaDefault=thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("AnchoDefault")
		thisform.LargoHojaDefault=thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("LargoDefault")
		thisform.Id_FontDraft=thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("FontDraft")
		thisform.Id_FontComprimido=thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("FontComprimido")
		thisform.Id_FontEnfatizadoDraft=thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("FontEnfatizadoDraft")
		thisform.Id_FontEnfatizadoComprimido=thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("FontEnfatizadoComprimido")	
		
		
		this.inicializar
		*!*	this.SoloTexto=(substr(thisform.NombreImpresora,1,1)="*")
		
		Do Case
			Case this.Salida=TG_IMPRESORA
			
				this.FontColorImpresion="Rgb(0,0,0,255,255,255)"
				
				If lActivarAlternate
					Set Console Off
					If this.AdjuntaArchivo	
						Set alternate to (cArchivo) Additive
					Else
						Set alternate to (cArchivo) 
					Endif	
					this.ArchivoGrabado=cArchivo
					Set Alternate on	
				Else	
					set printer to name alltrim(thisform.NombreImpresora)	
					*Set Device to Printer
					set printer on	
					Set console off	
				Endif	
		
				if .f.
					??? ""
					@ 0,0 say ""
				endif	
				
			Case this.Salida=TG_PANTALLA
			
				thisform.SetearCaption(alltrim(this.titulo)+" (pantalla)")
				this.largo=thisform.MaxRengPantalla
			*!*		this.largo=21
				this.archivoPantalla="X"+substr(sys(2015),4,10) && sacar asteriscos
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oBotones","tg_BtnListador",thisform)
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oBotonesMuestra","tg_BtnListadorMuestra")
				
				thisform.oBotones.SetearCaption(alltrim(this.titulo)+" (pantalla)")
				thisform.oBotonesMuestra.SetearCaption(alltrim(this.titulo)+" (pantalla)")
				
				thisform.oBotones.Width=thisform.Width
				thisform.oBotonesMuestra.Width=thisform.Width
				
				thisform.oBotones.Left=thisform.Left
				thisform.oBotonesMuestra.Left=thisform.Left
		
				thisform.oBotones.Top=thisform.Top
				thisform.oBotonesMuestra.Top=thisform.Top
			
				maliasold=alias()
				create table (this.archivoPantalla) free (Pagina n(6)  ,texto c(254),resaltado l(1)) 
				index on pagina  tag pagina
				set order to tag 1
				select (maliasold)
				
			Case this.Salida=TG_EXCEL
			
				this.archivoExcel="X"+substr(sys(2015),4,10) && sacar asteriscos
			
				mmmppp = 1
				
				maliasold=alias()
				cCampo=SubStr(Alltrim(Strtran(Alltrim(this.vtitulos[1,1])," ","_")),1,10)
				cCampo = ThisForm.ValidarCamposExcel(cCampo,.f.,this.ArchivoExcel)
				***Agregado por Luciano para la Fecha de Excel
				
				If Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("FechaExcel")
					mVarAux=this.vTitulos[1,2]
					Do Case
						Case Type(mVarAux)=T_NUMERIC
							** PROBLEMAS CON UN CAMPO NUMERICO CUANDO TIENE MAS DE 20 ENTEROS Y 19 DECIMALES EN TABLAS LIBRES, SE VALIDA ENTONCES
							** QUE NO SUPERE ESE RANGO
							***********Agregado VERSION 30/06/04
							If this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3]>20
								this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3]=20
							endif
							If this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4]>19
								this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4]=19
							endif
							***********************************************************
							create table (this.archivoExcel)  Free ((cCampo) n(this.vtitulos[1,3],this.vtitulos[1,4])) 
						Case Type(mVarAux)=T_DATE
							create table (this.archivoExcel)  Free ((cCampo) d(8)) 			
						OtherWise
							create table (this.archivoExcel)  Free ((cCampo) c(this.vtitulos[1,3])) 
						
					EndCase
				Else
					mVarAux=this.vTitulos[1,2]
					Do Case
						Case Type(mVarAux)=T_NUMERIC
							** PROBLEMAS CON UN CAMPO NUMERICO CUANDO TIENE MAS DE 20 ENTEROS Y 19 DECIMALES EN TABLAS LIBRES, SE VALIDA ENTONCES
							** QUE NO SUPERE ESE RANGO
							***********Agregado VERSION 30/06/04
							If this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3]>20
								this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3]=20
							endif
							If this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4]>19
								this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4]=19
							endif
							**************************************************
							create table (this.archivoExcel)  Free ((cCampo) n(this.vtitulos[1,3],this.vtitulos[1,4])) 
		*!*					Case Type(mVarAux)=T_DATE
		*!*						create table (this.archivoExcel)  Free ((cCampo) d(8)) 			
						OtherWise
							create table (this.archivoExcel)  Free ((cCampo) c(this.vtitulos[1,3])) 
						
					EndCase
				EndIf
				select (maliasold)
		
				For mmmppp=2 to alen(this.vtitulos,1)
					cCampo=SubStr(alltrim(Strtran(Alltrim(this.vtitulos[mmmppp,1])," ","_")),1,10)
					cCampo = ThisForm.ValidarCamposExcel(cCampo,.t.,this.ArchivoExcel)
					mVarAux=this.vTitulos[mmmppp,2]
					**** Fecha de Excel
					If Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("FechaExcel")
						Do Case
							Case Type(mVarAux)=T_NUMERIC
								** PROBLEMAS CON UN CAMPO NUMERICO CUANDO TIENE MAS DE 20 ENTEROS Y 19 DECIMALES EN TABLAS LIBRES, SE VALIDA ENTONCES
								** QUE NO SUPERE ESE RANGO
								***********Agregado VERSION 30/06/04
								If this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3]>20
									this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3]=20
								endif
								If this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4]>19
									this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4]=19
								endif
								**************************************************************
								alter Table (this.ArchivoExcel) Add Column (cCampo) n(this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3],this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4])				
							Case Type(mVarAux)=T_DATE
								alter Table (this.ArchivoExcel) Add Column (cCampo) d(8)
							OtherWise
								alter Table (this.ArchivoExcel) Add Column (cCampo) c(this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3])					
						EndCase
					Else
						Do Case
							Case Type(mVarAux)=T_NUMERIC
								** PROBLEMAS CON UN CAMPO NUMERICO CUANDO TIENE MAS DE 20 ENTEROS Y 19 DECIMALES EN TABLAS LIBRES, SE VALIDA ENTONCES
								** QUE NO SUPERE ESE RANGO
								***********Agregado VERSION 30/06/04
								If this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3]>20
									this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3]=20
								endif
								If this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4]>19
									this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4]=19
								endif
								************************************************************
		
								alter Table (this.ArchivoExcel) Add Column (cCampo) n(this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3],this.vtitulos[mmmppp,4])				
		*!*						Case Type(mVarAux)=T_DATE
		*!*							alter Table (this.ArchivoExcel) Add Column (cCampo) d(8)
							OtherWise
								alter Table (this.ArchivoExcel) Add Column (cCampo) c(this.vtitulos[mmmppp,3])					
						EndCase
					EndIf
				EndFor
				****** Se agrega esta columna para todos los textos, cortes de control, Etc...
				alter Table (this.ArchivoExcel) Add Column ('Texto') c(254)					
				select (maliasold)
		EndCase
		for mmpp=1 to alen(this.vtitulos,1)
			mvaraux=this.vtitulos[mmpp,1]
			if type("mvaraux")=T_CHARACTER	
				this.TitulosColumnas=this.TitulosColumnas+padc(this.vtitulos[mmpp,1],this.vtitulos[mmpp,3])
			
				if mmpp<alen(this.vtitulos,1)
					this.TitulosColumnas=this.TitulosColumnas+space(1)
				endif
				this.ancho=this.ancho+this.vtitulos[mmpp,3]
			endif
		endfor
		this.ancho=this.ancho+alen(this.vtitulos,1)-1 +this.SangriaFija
		
		this.vPrimeraPosicionColumna[1]=1
		For mmpp=2 to alen(this.vtitulos,1)
			Dimension this.vPrimeraPosicionColumna[mmpp]
			this.vPrimeraPosicionColumna[mmpp]=this.vPrimeraPosicionColumna[mmpp-1]+this.vTitulos[mmpp-1,3]+1
		EndFor
		
		Do case
			Case this.Salida=TG_IMPRESORA
				thisform.SetearAnchoImpresora
				If Upper(Set("Alternate"))="OFF"	
					set printer font thisform.FontNombreImpresion,thisform.FontTamanioImpresion style thisform.FontEstiloImpresion
				Endif	
				this.sangria=int((this.anchoImpresora-this.ancho)/2)				
			Case this.Salida=TG_PANTALLA
				if this.ancho>254
					this.ancho=254
				endif
				this.sangria=0
				this.TitulosColumnas=padr(this.titulosColumnas,this.ancho)
				thisform.tg_grid1.recordsource=thisform.archivoPantalla	
				
		
				thisform.tg_grid1.column1.controlsource="substr("+alltrim(this.ArchivoPantalla)+".texto"+",thisform.desdecaracter)"
				thisform.tg_textbox1.value=substr(this.titulosColumnas,thisform.desdecaracter)	
				thisform.oBotones.tg_commandbutton5.enabled=thisform.ancho>thisform.MaxCantCarAncho
				thisform.oBotones.tg_commandbutton9.enabled=thisform.ancho>thisform.MaxCantCarAncho	
			
		EndCase
		
		this.comenzarhoja
		Return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE comenzarlistadonet
		LOCAL i ,ContMargenE , Elemento, vGrabar(1),cXmlFondo,iAlto,iIndice,cFiltros,nEspacios, mmmppp, cDato
		
		AFIELDS(Thisform.vColumnasNet)
		thisform.xmlcolumnas=""
		thisform.xmlCortes=""
		Thisform.xmlPie=""
		Thisform.xmlpiefinal=""
		ContMargenE=0
		If Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"INTERLINEADO")
			iAlto=Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Tamaño")
		else
			iAlto=10
		Endif
		iIndice=1
		
		**** El vector vTitulos ya se encuentra Sin las columnas que no van y ordenadas.
		If Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Buscar(ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado)+ALLTRIM("DETALLE"))
			cXmlFondo=			"<fondocolores>"+CHR(13)
			cXmlFondo=cXmlFondo+	"<row fondodetalle='"+Thisform.DarColorRGB(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("ColorFondo"))+"'  "
			FOR i=1 TO ALEN(Thisform.vtitulos,1)
				If !Thisform.oTblColumnasReporte.Buscar(ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado)+Alltrim(Thisform.vTitulos(i,2)))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Listado",			ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"NombreCampo",		ALLTRIM(Thisform.vTitulos(i,2)))
																	&&&Multiplico por 7 para pasarlo a pixeles
					=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Ancho",			Thisform.DarAncho(Thisform.vtitulos[i,3]*7,Alltrim(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Fuente")),Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Tamaño")))
					Thisform.oTblColumnasReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
				EndIf
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<columnas>"+CHR(13)
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"titulo='"+Thisform.parseardato(Thisform.vtitulos[i,1])+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"campo='"+Thisform.parseardato(LOWER(Thisform.vtitulos[i,2]))+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"fuente='"+Alltrim(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Fuente"))+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"tamano='"+Alltrim(Str(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Tamaño")))+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"negrita='"+Iif(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Negrita"),"S","N")+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"cursiva='"+Iif(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Cursiva"),"S","N")+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"subrayado='"+Iif(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Subrayado"),"S","N")+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"color='"+Alltrim(Thisform.DarColorRGB(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("ColorLetra")))+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"alto='"+alltrim(str(iAlto))+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"marizq='"+ALLTRIM(STR(ContMargenE,10))+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"mararr='"+"0"+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"ancho='"+Alltrim(Str(Thisform.oTblColumnasReporte.Leer("Ancho")/iIndice))+"' "
				Elemento=ASCAN(Thisform.vColumnasNet,Iif(Upper(Substr(Thisform.vtitulos[i,2],1,9))="NCOLVALOR",Substr(Thisform.vtitulos[i,2],10),Thisform.vtitulos[i,2]))
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"tipodato='"+IIF(Elemento=0,'C',Thisform.vColumnasNet[Elemento+1])+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"simbolo='"+"X"+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"suma='"+Thisform.vTitulosOriginal[i,16]+"' "
				if(Thisform.vTitulosOriginal[i,10])&&Si existe el campo no lo sumariza
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"saldo='S' "		
				endif
				If rat(".",thisform.vTitulosOriginal[i,15])>0
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"decimales='"+Alltrim(Str(len(alltrim(thisform.vTitulosOriginal[i,15]))-rat(".",thisform.vTitulosOriginal[i,15])))+"' "
				Else
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"decimales='0' "
				endif
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"/>"+CHR(13)	
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"</columnas>"+CHR(13)
				ContMargenE=ContMargenE+Thisform.oTblColumnasReporte.Leer("Ancho")/iIndice
			Endfor
		Else
			cXmlFondo=			"<fondocolores>"+CHR(13)
			cXmlFondo=cXmlFondo+	"<row fondodetalle='"+"255,255,255"+"' "
			FOR i=1 TO ALEN(Thisform.vtitulos,1)
				If !Thisform.oTblColumnasReporte.Buscar(ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado)+Alltrim(Thisform.vTitulos(i,2)))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Listado",			ALLTRIM(Thisform.Listado))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"NombreCampo",		ALLTRIM(Thisform.vTitulos(i,2)))
																	&&&Multiplico por 7 para pasarlo a pixeles
					=fGrabar(@vGrabar,			"Ancho",			Thisform.DarAncho(Thisform.vtitulos[i,3]*7,"Courier New",8))
					Thisform.oTblColumnasReporte.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
				EndIf
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<columnas>"+CHR(13)
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"titulo='"+Thisform.parseardato(Thisform.vtitulos[i,1])+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"campo='"+Thisform.parseardato(LOWER(Thisform.vtitulos[i,2]))+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"fuente='"+"Courier New"+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"tamano='"+"8"+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"negrita='"+"N"+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"cursiva='"+"N"+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"subrayado='"+"N"+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"color='"+"0,0,0"+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"alto='"+alltrim(str(iAlto))+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"marizq='"+ALLTRIM(STR(ContMargenE,10))+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"mararr='"+"0"+"' "
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"ancho='"+Alltrim(Str(Thisform.oTblColumnasReporte.Leer("Ancho")/iIndice))+"' "

				cFiltros=cFiltros+"<row texto='"
				cFiltros=cFiltros+Alltrim(vFiltroR(mmpp,1))+Iif(nEspacios-Len(Alltrim(vFiltroR(mmpp,1)))>0,Replicate(" ",nEspacios-Len(Alltrim(vFiltroR(mmpp,1))))," ")
				cFiltros=cFiltros+Alltrim(vFiltroR(mmpp,5))+Iif(nEspacios-Len(Alltrim(vFiltroR(mmpp,5)))>0,Replicate(" ",nEspacios-Len(Alltrim(vFiltroR(mmpp,5))))," ")
				cFiltros=cFiltros+Alltrim(vFiltroR(mmpp,6))
				cFiltros=cFiltros+"'/>"+Chr(13)
				cFiltros=cFiltros+"</filtrosrango>"+Chr(13)
			Endif
		EndFor
		If !Empty(cFiltros)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<filtrosrango>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row texto='"
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+Alltrim("Filtro")+Replicate(" ",nEspacios-6)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+Alltrim("Desde")+Replicate(" ",nEspacios-5)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+Alltrim("Hasta")
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"'/>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"</filtrosrango>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+cFiltros
		Endif
		If Type("vFiltroS")<>T_LOGICAL
			For mmpp=1 to Alen(vFiltroS,1)
				If vFiltroS[mmpp,3]="Ninguno"
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<filtrosseleccion>"+Chr(13)
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row texto='"
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+Alltrim(vFiltroS(mmpp,1))+" "
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"No Seleccionados/as"
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"'/>"+Chr(13)
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"</filtrosseleccion>"+Chr(13)
				EndIf
				if vFiltroS[mmpp,3]="Algunos"
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<filtrosseleccion>"+Chr(13)
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row texto='"
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+Alltrim(vFiltroS(mmpp,1))+" "
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"Seleccionados/as"
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"'/>"+Chr(13)
					thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"</filtrosseleccion>"+Chr(13)
					mvaraux=alltrim(vFiltroS[mmpp,4])+"comp"
		
		
					for mmmppp=1 to alen(&mvaraux,1)
		
						if &mvaraux[mmmppp,2]
							thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<filtrosseleccion>"+Chr(13)
							thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row texto='"
							thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+Alltrim(&mvaraux[mmmppp,4])+" "
							thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+Alltrim(&mvaraux[mmmppp,1])
							thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"'/>"+Chr(13)
							thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"</filtrosseleccion>"+Chr(13)
		
						endif
					endfor
		
				EndIf
				
			Endfor
		EndIf
		
		If Type("vDatos[1,1]")<>T_LOGICAL
		
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<datos>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row texto='"
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"Datos"
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"'/>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"</datos>"+Chr(13)

					Case Type("vDatos[mmpp,2]")=T_DATE

				EndCase

				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row texto='"
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+vDatos[mmpp,1]+":    "+Alltrim(cDato)
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"'/>"+Chr(13)

			EndFor 
		Endif	
		
		
		
		
		If thisform.oTblParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"DETFILTRO")
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<detfiltros>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"titulo='DETFILTROS' " 
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"campo='DETFILTROS' "

			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"tamano='"+Alltrim(Str(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Tamaño")))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"negrita='"+Iif(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Negrita"),"S","N")+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"cursiva='"+Iif(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Cursiva"),"S","N")+"' "

			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"subrayado='"+Iif(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Subrayado"),"S","N")+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"color='"+Thisform.DarColorRGB(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("ColorLetra"))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"alto='"+ALLTRIM(Str(FONTMETRIC(1 ,Alltrim(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Fuente")),Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Tamaño"))))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"marizq='"+"0"+"' "

			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"colorfondo='"+Thisform.DarColorRGB(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("ColorFondo"))+"' "

			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"colorfondo='"+"255,255,255"+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"/>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"</titfiltros>"+Chr(13)
		endif
		
		If thisform.oTblParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"EMPRESA")
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<empresa>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"titulo='EMPRESA' " 
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"campo='EMPRESA' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"fuente='"+Alltrim(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Fuente"))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"tamano='"+Alltrim(Str(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Tamaño")))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"negrita='"+Iif(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Negrita"),"S","N")+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"cursiva='"+Iif(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Cursiva"),"S","N")+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"subrayado='"+Iif(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Subrayado"),"S","N")+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"color='"+Thisform.DarColorRGB(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("ColorLetra"))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"alto='"+alltrim(str(iAlto))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"marizq='"+"0"+"' "

			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"ancho='"+Alltrim(Str(Thisform.DarAncho(20*7,Alltrim(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Fuente")),Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("Tamaño"))))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"colorfondo='"+Thisform.DarColorRGB(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("ColorFondo"))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"texto='"+Iif(Type("oapp.nombreempresa")=T_CHARACTER,oapp.nombreempresa,"")+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"/>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"</empresa>"+Chr(13)
		
		else	 
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<empresa>"+Chr(13)

			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"titulo='EMPRESA' "

			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"fuente='"+"Courier New"+"' "

			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"negrita='"+"N"+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"cursiva='"+"N"+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"subrayado='"+"N"+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"color='"+"0,0,0"+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"alto='"+alltrim(str(iAlto))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"marizq='"+"0"+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"mararr='"+"0"+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"texto='"+Iif(Type("oapp.nombreempresa")=T_CHARACTER,oapp.nombreempresa,"")+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"ancho='"+Alltrim(Str(Thisform.DarAncho(20*7,"Courier New",8)))+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"colorfondo='"+"255,255,255"+"' "
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"/>"+Chr(13)
			thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"</empresa>"+Chr(13)
		endif
		
		thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<margenes>"+Chr(13)
		thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"<row "
		If Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Buscar(Alltrim(Thisform.Listado)+"MARGENSUP")
			If Thisform.puntodecimal=Set("Point")
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"margensup='"+Str(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("TamMargen"),10,2)+"' "
			Else
				thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"margensup='"+Strtran(Str(Thisform.oTblParamReporte.Leer("TamMargen"),10,2),Set("Point"),Thisform.puntodecimal)+"' "
			Endif
		Else
			*If Thisform.puntodecimal=Set("Point")
			*	thisform.xmlcolumnas=thisform.xmlcolumnas+"margensup='"+Str(2.54,10,2)+"' "
			*Else
